title: Customers receiving incorrect items in their orders
situation: High volume of complaints regarding incorrect product fulfillment requiring immediate resolution to maintain customer trust.

actions.why: Acknowledge the error and initiate the return/replacement process.

params.title: Incorrect item received process
params.answer_en: We are sorry you received the wrong item. Please initiate a return through your order history, and we will ship the correct item immediately.
params.answer_ar: نعتذر عن استلامك منتجاً غير صحيح. يرجى بدء طلب إرجاع من سجل طلباتك، وسنقوم بشحن المنتج الصحيح لك فوراً.

actions.why: Standardize the response for incorrect item reports.

reply_en: We are sorry you received the wrong item. Please initiate a return through your order history, and we will ship the correct item immediately.
reply_ar: نعتذر عن استلامك منتجاً غير صحيح. يرجى بدء طلب إرجاع من سجل طلباتك، وسنقوم بشحن المنتج الصحيح لك فوراً.

alternatives.why: Some customers mentioned poor condition, though most report receiving entirely different products.
Multiple reports of specific incorrect items suggest a potential catalog mapping error.
